headline: Sonny Gray dominates and Contreras goes deep to lead the local nine over Kansas City
morning_brew: Sonny Gray was absolutely dealing last night. Six innings with nine strikeouts is exactly the kind of veteran performance this rotation needs to stay afloat. Willson Contreras provided the power with his tenth home run of the year to give the squad a cushion. It was a clean game from the field and the bullpen did their job to secure the three to one victory. Getting a win like this to start the series in Kansas City helps wash out the taste of that last road trip.

The news cycle in Foxborough is focusing on the people behind the scenes this week. Nancy Meier has been with the team through everything and her retirement is well deserved after all those years of service. It is certainly more productive than reading about former guys on the fashion catwalk in New York during their spare time. We are looking for some actual roster news as the summer approaches because the fans are getting restless for real football moves.

Offseason talk is the only thing going at the Garden right now. Seeing the Celtics leading the league in all-time MVP winners is a great bit of history to lean on during the break. It reminds you of the standards in this town when things are going right. Both front offices better be on the phone right now because this city does not handle early exits well. We need to see some real moves before the leaves start turning and the pressure ramps up again.

news_digest.headline: Red Sox beat Royals 3-1 behind Willson Contreras' homer and Sonny Gray's strong outing
news_digest.dans_take: Gutsy win to start the series and Sonny Gray looked like a true ace out there.

news_digest.headline: Which NBA teams have the most MVP awards?
news_digest.dans_take: The history is great but we are all waiting to see who is going to be the next one to bring a title home.

news_digest.headline: Rob Gronkowski again named grand marshal of Indy 500 Snake Pit
news_digest.dans_take: Gronk is going to be Gronk, hope everyone at the track has a safe and fun time.

trend_watch.dans_take: Exactly the kind of veteran performance we need to settle the rotation.

trend_watch.trend: Hit his team-leading tenth home run of the season.
trend_watch.dans_take: He is the only one consistently driving the ball right now.

trend_watch.trend: Struck out two in a clean seventh inning.
trend_watch.dans_take: The bullpen looks much better when the starters actually go deep.
